newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian privatisation agency to open on Internet.
newsitem.headline: Latvian privatisation agency to open on Internet.

text.p: The Latvian Privatisation agency (LPA) on Wednesday launched a home page on the Internet which has on-line data on some 300 companies which are to be sold.
"The main idea of the home page is to inform people about the companies available for privatisation," LPA head Janis Naglis told a news conference.
The agency's website, to found at www.lpa.bkc.lv, will offer a regularly updated database which uses an international four-digit classification code for different industries.
The LPA's international marketing unit has worked on the project, which is financed by EU Phare, since September 1996.
